entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this ridiculous jersey I bought. It's a complete joke.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you provide me with your order number?
It's VF-8675309. And don't give me the runaround. I bought this thing a couple of months ago, and I just tried it on. It's completely the wrong size. I want my money back. Now.

Okay, I have your order pulled up. I see the ProFit Jersey purchased 73 days ago. So I can best assist you, could you clarify the issue? Is it a technical fault with the fabric, or more of a preference issue with the fit?

Are you kidding me? It's too tight! I can barely breathe in this thing. It's the wrong size, simple as that. I need an exchange or a refund, and if you can't do it, put your manager on the phone. I'm not wasting my Christmas on this.
I understand your frustration completely, and there's no need for a manager. I can handle this for you. Let me just quickly review our policy for the jersey.
You'd better. Because I swear I will light you up on every review site on the internet if you deny this. This is terrible service.

I appreciate your patience. Okay, I've confirmed it. Your ProFit jersey is a standard item, and it's well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund or an exchange for you right now. Which would you prefer?
Oh. Really? Ninety days? Well... okay then. A refund. Just process the refund.

Of course. I've just initiated that for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the jersey, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
